description: An `audit @slog` clause inside a §51.0 STATE-CHILD engine body. The clause has no effect in that form, so it is rejected with E-ENGINE-AUDIT-UNSUPPORTED-BODY (§34: Error).
rationale: §51.11 — the audit clause is read from the arrow-rules body. In the state-child form it is parsed as body text and dropped: measured, such a program emits ZERO audit-push sites. Before S307 it also emitted zero diagnostics, so an author who wrote `audit` received no log and no signal — a fail-OPEN outcome. The clause is rejected rather than ignored because rejection is the reversible direction (declare the engine in the named/legacy form §51.3.2, or drop the clause), while accepting-and-ignoring silently withholds a guarantee the author asked for.
